CustomField.description: A follow-up reminder is sent to the Onboarding Owner after 60 days if the client Onboarding Status is still pending.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK( Onboarding_Pending_Start_Date__c )), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Onboarding Pending"), TODAY() - Onboarding_Pending_Start_Date__c >= 60 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field is automatically populated once the 60-day reminder email has been sent to the client, triggered when the Onboarding status has been in Pending for 60 days.
CustomField.label: 60-day reminder
